item.title: About Me
item.description:
Profile

I am Yifan Guo, a Robotics undergraduate at Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech). My work spans robotic perception, reinforcement learning, embedded control, and mechanical prototyping.

Education

B.S. in Robotics
Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, China | Expected June 2027

  • GPA: 3.77/4.00; average: 90.87/100
  • Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Control Engineering, Robot Modeling and Control, Mechatronics

Research Experience

Vision-LiDAR Fusion for 3D Target Localization

Built a synchronized perception pipeline combining YOLO, Livox point-cloud projection, clustering, and 2D-3D association. Validation against motion-capture ground truth showed that 95% of detections within 5 m had 3D localization error below 10 cm.

Vision-Based Dexterous-Hand Grasping

Built an Isaac Gym and UniDexGrasp++-based grasp-training pipeline, processed RGB-D observations into point-cloud inputs, debugged Arduino multi-motor control, and deployed trained policies on Jetson Nano Super.

Metamorphic-Structure Reconfigurable Aircraft

Participated in the mechanical and control design of an aircraft that switches between airship and fixed-wing configurations. Built the Gazebo/ROS 2 simulation environment and worked with Pixhawk, QGroundControl, STM32, and Arduino.

Technical Skills

  • Programming: C++, Python, Linux/Ubuntu, Git, Docker, PyTorch
  • Robotics systems: ROS 2, Gazebo, Isaac Gym, Pixhawk, QGroundControl, STM32, Arduino, NVIDIA Jetson
  • Perception: OpenCV, YOLO, RGB-D processing, point-cloud processing, LiDAR-camera calibration, 3D localization
  • Learning and control: Reinforcement learning, robotic grasping, embedded motor control
  • Design: SolidWorks

Honors, Awards, and Funding

  • National-level Funded Project, College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program, 2026
  • National Third Prize, National College Student Mechanical Innovation Competition, 2026
  • Provincial First Prize, National College Student Mechanical Innovation Competition, Bionic Butterfly Track, 2026
  • Provincial First Prize, Guangdong Engineering Maker Competition; team ranked second overall in category, 2025
  • SUSTech Climbing Program Research Grant, RMB 20,000, 2025

Patent Application

Metamorphic Aircraft, Chinese Invention Patent Application No. 2026102057666; co-inventor, third listed; accepted by CNIPA.
